title: Disentangling the social from the aesthetic: neuropsychology for urban design
journal: Future Cities — City Futures: Emerging Urban Perspectives (TU Delft OPEN Books)
authors: Mavros, P., Olszewska-Guizzo, A., & Makowski, D.
summary: A book chapter arguing that research on how people respond to urban space conflates two different things — a place's social content and its aesthetic properties — and setting out how neuropsychological methods can pull the two apart.
